findings.body: Defaulting an omitted stage to live changes the behavior of existing tests that still create client repos without `stage`. `tests/test_proto_gate.py:16` expects those repos to block stories and grant the prototype fix allowance; `tests/test_proto_next.py:11` expects sign-off notices. The shared fixture at `tests/test_close.py:229` also omits stage, while `tests/test_sales_merge.py:20` and `tests/test_aha_review.py:29` expect prototype merge and light-review behavior. These tests are in the configured `pytest tests` suite and will fail. Set `stage = "prototype"` in fixtures exercising prototype behavior, while retaining unstaged fixtures for the new live-default checks.
